mapper.sql: ( SELECT pi.part_id, sup.supplier_name, ps.supply_type, psp.price_type, psp.price_value, psp.moq, psp.lead_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pi.part_id ORDER BY ) AS rn FROM part_supplier_price psp INNER JOIN part_supplier ps ON ps.ps_id = psp.ps_id AND ps.auth_status = 1 INNER JOIN part_info pi ON pi.part_id = ps.part_id LEFT JOIN supplier sup ON sup.supplier_id = ps.supplier_id WHERE ps.supply_type IN ('main', 'spare') AND ) price
mapper.select:
SELECT s.scheme_id, s.scheme_name, s.create_time, COUNT(sp.scheme_part_id) AS part_count, SUM(CASE WHEN price.price_value IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE price.price_value * sp.quantity END) AS total_price, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN sp.is_select_bom = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_select_bom FROM selection_scheme s LEFT JOIN scheme_part sp ON sp.scheme_id = s.scheme_id LEFT JOIN ON price.part_id = sp.part_id AND price.rn = 1
AND s.scheme_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY s.scheme_id, s.scheme_name, s.create_time ORDER BY s.create_time DESC, s.scheme_id DESC

SELECT s.scheme_id, s.scheme_name, s.remark, s.user_id, s.create_time, s.update_time, u.real_name AS user_name, COUNT(sp.scheme_part_id) AS part_count, SUM(CASE WHEN price.price_value IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE price.price_value * sp.quantity END) AS total_price FROM selection_scheme s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN scheme_part sp ON sp.scheme_id = s.scheme_id LEFT JOIN ON price.part_id = sp.part_id AND price.rn = 1 WHERE s.scheme_id = #{schemeId} GROUP BY s.scheme_id, s.scheme_name, s.remark, s.user_id, s.create_time, s.update_time, u.real_name
